chunks.title: Q4 — Logarithmic / Trigonometric / Rational Functions (6 points, no calculator)
chunks.content: AP Precalculus FRQ 4 (Part B, graphing calculator not allowed), 6 points, scored by lettered subparts. Q4 topic: analyzing logarithmic, trigonometric, and/or rational functions (domain/asymptotes, exact solutions of equations, transformations, and interpretation). Points reward: correct exact algebraic manipulation and solutions with work, correct identification of features (asymptotes, domain, zeros), and correct interpretation. Common failure: log/exponent rule errors; missing restrictions/asymptotes for rational functions; approximations where exact values are required; incomplete work.
